meta.title: Provod spending
meta.description: Adds a "Spending" entry to the sidebar panel list: today and month-to-date totals, a month-end forecast, spending by day, a bar breakdown by model with a table, model efficiency (input cache hits, error share, response time, speed and price per million tokens) and latency by model — median, p90 and medians at a similar output size. Requires a Provod workspace management key: paste it into the page's "Key" section (it is kept in the DSH credential store) or set PROVOD_MANAGEMENT_API_KEY. Each refresh makes four requests to api.provod.ai from this machine and sends only the key and the two date ranges; the key itself never reaches the browser. Response time is the full request duration with no separate time-to-first-token, and models get different tasks, so a latency difference does not prove a speed difference on the same work. Spending is grouped by booking time while request counts are grouped by completion time, so averages and the forecast are approximate; Provod limits analytics to 2 requests per second and 30 per minute. Turning the plugin off removes the page and the routes; no Session data is read or changed.
